Euler's Identity

Since \(z = x + jy\) we have polar form

\begin{equation}\fbox{$\displaystyle e^{j\theta}=\cos(\theta)+j\sin(\theta)$}\label{eq:e}\end{equation}

and \(\abs{z}^2 = z\overline{z}\).
